name: nav-emissions
prompt:
This dynamometer emissions test says the car fails on CO2 by a factor of ten. Two things are wrong:

  1. The CO2 conversion from fuel burned is off: petrol produces 2392 g of CO2 per LITRE, but fuel is measured in millilitres.
  2. The extra-high phase of the cycle contains no samples at all; it should run from its start time to the end of the cycle.

The program is long and flat; find the definitions responsible before editing. Check the program's value after each fix. When every fix is in and the program evaluates cleanly, say DONE and stop.
expectation: Navigation-hard by volume: 98 mostly top-level bindings (per-phase statistics repeated four times, an appendix, nested limits), so the targets are needles in a long flat list rather than deep in modules. Two fixes, far apart: co2_grams (unit conversion, near the top) and extra_high_samples (the fourth phase block). Each is observable: the conversion alone gives (144, 38, "FAIL-CO2"), the phase alone (1370, 35, "FAIL-CO2"); only both give PASS. Expected answer (136, 35, "PASS"): CO2 g/km, NOx mg/km, verdict.
